name: Ryan Blender
source:
Ryan is a private investigator who has been mostly dealing in domestic cases of boyfriend and husbands asking Ryan to tail their significant others and see of they are cheating on them. But when a young married woman comes into his office and asks for his help, Ryan realizes that this case may help him elevate him in the business.

[From [url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Ryan_Blender]Lesson of Passion Wiki[/url]]
translation:
瑞安是一名私家侦探，主要处理男友和丈夫的家庭案件，要求瑞安跟踪他们的重要他人，看看他们是否欺骗了他们。但当一位年轻的已婚妇女来到他的办公室寻求他的帮助时，瑞安意识到这个案子可能会帮助他在事业上得到提升。

[来自[url=http://lessonofpassion.wikia.com/wiki/Ryan_Blender]激情课程维基[/url]]
